translations.web: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
translations.bsb: And God looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt; for all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways.
translations.kjv: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
